translator_notes: '=' on a line (the two intro lines, 'The Animated Zoo!') keeps the ENGLISH recording: it is the channel's name and the logo on screen says it in English. Say if Milo should say it in Spanish ('¡El Zoo Animado!').
'Mamá' for 'Mama'; Sandy, Tumble, Milo and Poppy are unchanged. Sandy is 'la camellita' (she).
Camel 'hum': 'tararear' / 'tarareo', and 'la canción de Mamá' for the tune. Neutral Latin American words: 'pijamada', 'granero', 'de puntitas', 'calladito'.
The lullaby rhyme is adapted: 'Luna redonda, estrellas a brillar. Cierra los ojos, vamos a soñar.' (brillar / soñar).
'primero las rodillas' is said once (line 20). Line 42 says 'en la puerta' without 'del zoológico' (4.2 s).
The star count is spoken inside the English line's time: the numbers in the picture light up on the ENGLISH words' times.
Words in the picture (SLEEPOVER!, the answer signs, the logo) are English: one picture for every language (docs/multilang/PLAN.md, decision 1).

line_table.text: ¡Una pijamada! Sandy, ¡estás invitada a dormir en el zoológico!
line_table.english: A sleepover! Sandy, you are invited to a sleepover at the zoo!

line_table.text: The Animated Zoo!
line_table.english: The Animated Zoo!

line_table.text: ¡Hola, soy Milo! Ella es Sandy, la camellita bebé, y su Mamá, en el desierto.
line_table.english: Hello, I'm Milo! This is Sandy the baby camel, and her Mama, in the sandy desert.

line_table.text: ¿Una pijamada? ¡Mi primera noche lejos de Mamá!
line_table.english: A sleepover? My very first night away from Mama!

line_table.text: Mamá camella acaricia a Sandy. Diviértete, pequeña. En la mañana te espero en la puerta del zoológico.
line_table.english: Mama camel nuzzles Sandy. Have fun, little one. I will be at the zoo gate in the morning.

line_table.text: ¿Dónde va a dormir Sandy esta noche? ¿En el zoológico, o en casa?
line_table.english: Where will Sandy sleep tonight? At the zoo, or at home?

line_table.text: Sandy camina junto a Mamá, paso, paso, paso, hasta el zoológico.
line_table.english: Sandy walks beside Mama, step, step, step, all the way to the zoo.

line_table.text: ¡Un camellito bebé puede caminar junto a su mamá con solo media hora de nacido!
line_table.english: A baby camel can walk beside its mama, when it is only half an hour old!

line_table.text: ¿Un camellito puede caminar poco después de nacer? ¿Sí, o no?
line_table.english: Can a baby camel walk, soon after it is born? Yes, or no?

line_table.text: En el zoológico espera Tumble, el elefantito. ¡Viva, una pijamada!
line_table.english: At the zoo, Tumble the baby elephant is waiting. Hooray, a sleepover!

line_table.text: ¡Hola, Sandy! ¡Vamos a jugar, a cenar y a dormir en el granero!
line_table.english: Hi, Sandy! We can play, and have supper, and sleep in the cozy barn!

line_table.text: ¡Adiós, Mamá! ¡Nos vemos en la mañana!
line_table.english: Bye-bye, Mama! See you in the morning!

line_table.text: Juegan a las escondidas y comen una cena rica. ¡Ñam, ñam!
line_table.english: They play hide and seek, and eat a yummy supper. Munch, munch!

line_table.text: ¡Hora de dormir! En el granero, Tumble tiene una cama grande y esponjosa para Sandy.
line_table.english: Bedtime! In the cozy barn, Tumble has a big, fluffy bed for Sandy.

line_table.text: ¡Se mueve, se mueve! ¡Ay, esta cama es muy blanda! ¡Me hundo, hundo, hundo!
line_table.english: Wobble, wobble! Oh, this bed is too soft! I sink down, down, down!

line_table.text: ¿La cama esponjosa es muy blanda, o muy dura?
line_table.english: Is the fluffy bed too soft, or too hard?

line_table.text: En casa, me arrodillo en la arena tibia.
line_table.english: At home, I kneel down on the warm sand, knees first.

line_table.text: Los camellos tienen piel gruesa y dura en las rodillas, para arrodillarse en la arena caliente.
line_table.english: Camels have thick, tough skin on their knees, so they can kneel down on hot sand.

line_table.text: ¿Dónde tienen los camellos la piel gruesa y dura? ¿En las rodillas, o en las orejas?
line_table.english: Where do camels have tough, thick skin? On their knees, or on their ears?

line_table.text: Tumble trae paja suave. Sandy se arrodilla, primero las rodillas. ¡Ahh, perfecto!
line_table.english: Tumble brings soft straw. Sandy kneels down, knees first. Ahh, just right!

line_table.text: Pero ahora hay mucho silencio. En casa, el viento del desierto hace fuuush.
line_table.english: But now it is so quiet. At home, the desert wind goes whoosh.

line_table.text: ¡Ya sé! ¡Salgamos de puntitas a ver las estrellas!
line_table.english: I know! Let's tiptoe outside, and look at the stars!

line_table.text: En el jardín del zoológico, la luna está redonda y brillante, y el cielo, lleno de estrellas.
line_table.english: In the zoo garden, the moon is round and bright, and the sky is full of stars.

line_table.text: ¿Cuántas estrellas grandes ves? ¡Cuenta conmigo! ¡Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco!
line_table.english: How many big stars can you see? Count with me! One, two, three, four, five!

line_table.text: ¡Shhh! ¿Puedes estar muy calladito, como la noche?
line_table.english: Hush, hush! Can you be very quiet, like the night?

line_table.text: Las estrellas son muy lindas. Pero sigo bien despierta.
line_table.english: The stars are so pretty. But I am still wide awake.

line_table.text: ¿Es de día, o de noche?
line_table.english: Is it day, or night?

line_table.text: De vuelta en el granero, Sandy se acuesta en la paja. Sus ojos siguen abiertos.
line_table.english: Back in the barn, Sandy lies in the straw. Her eyes stay open.

line_table.text: En casa, Mamá me tararea cada noche. Extraño el tarareo de Mamá.
line_table.english: At home, Mama hums to me every night. I miss Mama's hum.

line_table.text: Lejos, en el desierto, Mamá camella mira la misma luna grande.
line_table.english: Far away in the desert, Mama camel looks up at the same big moon.

line_table.text: ¡Las mamás camello y sus bebés se tararean!
line_table.english: Camel mamas and their babies hum to each other!

line_table.text: ¿Qué hacen las mamás camello y sus bebés? ¿Tararean, o rugen?
line_table.english: What do camel mamas and babies do? Hum, or roar?

line_table.text: El granero está callado y oscuro, y Mamá está lejos. Sandy se siente un poquito triste.
line_table.english: The barn is quiet and dark, and Mama is far away. Sandy feels a little sad.

line_table.text: ¿Seré muy pequeña para una pijamada?
line_table.english: Maybe I am too little for a sleepover.

line_table.text: Tranquila, Sandy. Estamos aquí contigo.
line_table.english: Don't worry, Sandy. We are right here with you.

line_table.text: ¿Los buenos amigos pueden ayudar a Sandy a sentirse mejor? ¿Sí, o no?
line_table.english: Can good friends help Sandy feel better? Yes, or no?

line_table.text: ¡Ya sé! Les enseño el tarareo de Mamá. ¡Así, un pedacito de casa está aquí!
line_table.english: I know! I can teach you Mama's hum. Then a little bit of home is here with us!

line_table.text: ¡Sí! ¡Enséñanos, Sandy! Tumble y Milo se acurrucan cerquita.
line_table.english: Yes! Teach us, Sandy! Tumble and Milo snuggle up close.

line_table.text: Luna redonda, estrellas a brillar. Cierra los ojos, vamos a soñar.
line_table.english: Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!

line_table.text: Sus amigos tararean la canción de Mamá, suave y despacito. Y Sandy se queda dormida. ¡Dulces sueños!
line_table.english: Her friends hum Mama's tune with her, soft and slow. And Sandy falls fast asleep. Sweet dreams!

line_table.text: ¿Qué ayudó a Sandy a dormirse? ¿La canción de Mamá, o un tambor ruidoso?
line_table.english: What helped Sandy fall asleep? Mama's tune, or a loud drum?

line_table.text: ¡Buenos días! Salió el sol. ¡Y mira quién está en la puerta!
line_table.english: Good morning! The sun is up. And look who is at the zoo gate!

line_table.text: ¡Mamá! ¡Dormí toda la noche! Mis amigos tararearon tu canción conmigo.
line_table.english: Mama! I slept all night! My friends hummed your tune with me.

line_table.text: Mamá camella y Sandy se tararean hola, nariz con nariz.
line_table.english: Mama camel and Sandy hum hello, nose to nose.

line_table.text: Luego, Mamá y Sandy caminan a casa, lado a lado.
line_table.english: Then Mama and Sandy walk home together, side by side.

line_table.text: ¿Quién esperaba en la puerta? ¿Mamá, o Milo?
line_table.english: Who was waiting at the gate? Mama, or Milo?

line_table.text: ¡Gracias por la pijamada, Sandy!
line_table.english: Thank you for the sleepover, Sandy!

line_table.text: ¡Vuelve pronto! Nuestro granero también es tuyo.
line_table.english: Come again soon! Our barn is your barn too.

line_table.text: ¡Gracias, amigos! Mi primera noche fuera fue muy acogedora.
line_table.english: Thank you, friends! You made my first night away so cozy.

line_table.text: Cuando extrañas a alguien, una canción de casa puede ir contigo. Y los buenos amigos también ayudan.
line_table.english: When you miss someone, a song from home can come with you. And good friends help, too.

line_table.text: ¿Te acuerdas? ¿Cuándo puede un camellito caminar junto a su mamá? ¿Con media hora de nacido, o con un año?
line_table.english: Do you remember? When can a baby camel walk beside its mama? At half an hour old, or at one year old?

line_table.text: ¿Y qué protege las rodillas del camello en la arena caliente? ¿Piel dura, o plumas suaves?
line_table.english: And what keeps a camel's knees safe on hot sand? Tough skin, or soft feathers?

line_table.text: Luna redonda, estrellas a brillar. Cierra los ojos, vamos a soñar.
line_table.english: Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!

line_table.text: La próxima vez: ¡Poppy se desliza en el hielo por primera vez! ¡Nos vemos en la próxima aventura, amigos!
line_table.english: Next time: Poppy's first slide on the ice! See you on the next adventure, friends!

line_table.text: The Animated Zoo!
line_table.english: The Animated Zoo!

translator_notes: '=' on a line (the two intro lines, 'The Animated Zoo!') keeps the ENGLISH recording: it is the channel's name and the logo on screen says it in English. Say if Milo should say it in Portuguese ('O Zoológico Animado!').
'Mamãe' for 'Mama' (as in zc_ep02); Sandy, Tumble, Milo and Poppy are unchanged. Sandy is 'a camelinha' (she), so 'Obrigada', 'acordada', 'pequena'.
Camel 'hum': 'cantarolar' (the verb) and 'cantiga' (the tune). The fact line says 'cantarolam um pro outro' (spoken Brazilian 'pro').
The lullaby rhyme is adapted, not translated: 'Lua redonda, estrelas a brilhar. Feche os olhos, vamos sonhar!' (brilhar / sonhar).
'knees first' is said once (line 20), not twice: line 17 has 3.6 s. Milo's thank-you avoids 'obrigado/obrigada' ('Adorei a festa do pijama').
The star count 'Um, dois, três, quatro, cinco' is spoken inside the English line's time: the numbers in the picture light up on the ENGLISH words' times, so they may be a beat off.
Words in the picture (SLEEPOVER!, the answer signs, the logo) are English: one picture for every language (docs/multilang/PLAN.md, decision 1).

line_table.text: Festa do pijama! Sandy, você vai dormir no zoológico!
line_table.english: A sleepover! Sandy, you are invited to a sleepover at the zoo!

line_table.text: The Animated Zoo!
line_table.english: The Animated Zoo!

line_table.text: Oi, eu sou o Milo! Esta é a Sandy, a camelinha, e a Mamãe dela, lá no deserto.
line_table.english: Hello, I'm Milo! This is Sandy the baby camel, and her Mama, in the sandy desert.

line_table.text: Dormir fora? Minha primeira noite longe da Mamãe!
line_table.english: A sleepover? My very first night away from Mama!

line_table.text: A Mamãe faz um carinho na Sandy. Divirta-se, filhinha! De manhã, te espero no portão.
line_table.english: Mama camel nuzzles Sandy. Have fun, little one. I will be at the zoo gate in the morning.

line_table.text: Onde a Sandy vai dormir hoje? No zoológico, ou em casa?
line_table.english: Where will Sandy sleep tonight? At the zoo, or at home?

line_table.text: A Sandy anda ao lado da Mamãe, passo, passo, passo, até o zoológico.
line_table.english: Sandy walks beside Mama, step, step, step, all the way to the zoo.

line_table.text: Um camelinho bebê já anda ao lado da mamãe com só meia hora de vida!
line_table.english: A baby camel can walk beside its mama, when it is only half an hour old!

line_table.text: Um camelinho consegue andar logo depois de nascer? Sim, ou não?
line_table.english: Can a baby camel walk, soon after it is born? Yes, or no?

line_table.text: No zoológico, o elefantinho Tumble espera. Oba, festa do pijama!
line_table.english: At the zoo, Tumble the baby elephant is waiting. Hooray, a sleepover!

line_table.text: Oi, Sandy! Vamos brincar, jantar e dormir no celeiro quentinho!
line_table.english: Hi, Sandy! We can play, and have supper, and sleep in the cozy barn!

line_table.text: Tchau, Mamãe! Até de manhã!
line_table.english: Bye-bye, Mama! See you in the morning!

line_table.text: Eles brincam de esconde-esconde e comem um jantar gostoso. Nham, nham!
line_table.english: They play hide and seek, and eat a yummy supper. Munch, munch!

line_table.text: Hora de dormir! No celeiro, o Tumble tem uma cama grande e fofinha para a Sandy.
line_table.english: Bedtime! In the cozy barn, Tumble has a big, fluffy bed for Sandy.

line_table.text: Balança, balança! Ai, esta cama é mole demais! Eu afundo, fundo, fundo!
line_table.english: Wobble, wobble! Oh, this bed is too soft! I sink down, down, down!

line_table.text: A cama fofinha é mole demais, ou dura demais?
line_table.english: Is the fluffy bed too soft, or too hard?

line_table.text: Em casa, eu me ajoelho na areia quentinha.
line_table.english: At home, I kneel down on the warm sand, knees first.

line_table.text: Os camelos têm uma pele grossa e forte nos joelhos, para se ajoelhar na areia quente.
line_table.english: Camels have thick, tough skin on their knees, so they can kneel down on hot sand.

line_table.text: Onde os camelos têm a pele grossa e forte? Nos joelhos, ou nas orelhas?
line_table.english: Where do camels have tough, thick skin? On their knees, or on their ears?

line_table.text: O Tumble traz palha macia. A Sandy se ajoelha, primeiro os joelhos. Ahh, perfeito!
line_table.english: Tumble brings soft straw. Sandy kneels down, knees first. Ahh, just right!

line_table.text: Mas agora está tão quieto. Em casa, o vento do deserto faz vuuush.
line_table.english: But now it is so quiet. At home, the desert wind goes whoosh.

line_table.text: Já sei! Vamos lá fora, na pontinha dos pés, ver as estrelas!
line_table.english: I know! Let's tiptoe outside, and look at the stars!

line_table.text: No jardim do zoo, a lua está redonda e brilhante, e o céu, cheio de estrelas.
line_table.english: In the zoo garden, the moon is round and bright, and the sky is full of stars.

line_table.text: Quantas estrelas grandes você vê? Conte comigo! Um, dois, três, quatro, cinco!
line_table.english: How many big stars can you see? Count with me! One, two, three, four, five!

line_table.text: Shhh! Você consegue ficar bem quietinho, como a noite?
line_table.english: Hush, hush! Can you be very quiet, like the night?

line_table.text: As estrelas são lindas. Mas eu ainda estou acordada.
line_table.english: The stars are so pretty. But I am still wide awake.

line_table.text: É dia, ou é noite?
line_table.english: Is it day, or night?

line_table.text: De volta ao celeiro, a Sandy deita na palha. Os olhos continuam abertos.
line_table.english: Back in the barn, Sandy lies in the straw. Her eyes stay open.

line_table.text: Em casa, a Mamãe cantarola para mim toda noite. Que saudade!
line_table.english: At home, Mama hums to me every night. I miss Mama's hum.

line_table.text: Lá longe, no deserto, a Mamãe camelo olha para a mesma lua grande.
line_table.english: Far away in the desert, Mama camel looks up at the same big moon.

line_table.text: A mamãe camelo e o bebê cantarolam um pro outro!
line_table.english: Camel mamas and their babies hum to each other!

line_table.text: O que a mamãe camelo e o bebê fazem? Cantarolam, ou rugem?
line_table.english: What do camel mamas and babies do? Hum, or roar?

line_table.text: O celeiro está quieto e escuro, e a Mamãe está longe. A Sandy fica um pouquinho triste.
line_table.english: The barn is quiet and dark, and Mama is far away. Sandy feels a little sad.

line_table.text: Será que sou pequena demais?
line_table.english: Maybe I am too little for a sleepover.

line_table.text: Calma, Sandy. Estamos aqui com você.
line_table.english: Don't worry, Sandy. We are right here with you.

line_table.text: Bons amigos podem ajudar a Sandy a se sentir melhor? Sim, ou não?
line_table.english: Can good friends help Sandy feel better? Yes, or no?

line_table.text: Já sei! Eu ensino a cantiga da Mamãe. Assim, um pedacinho de casa fica aqui!
line_table.english: I know! I can teach you Mama's hum. Then a little bit of home is here with us!

line_table.text: Isso! Ensina, Sandy! O Tumble e o Milo chegam bem pertinho.
line_table.english: Yes! Teach us, Sandy! Tumble and Milo snuggle up close.

line_table.text: Lua redonda, estrelas a brilhar. Feche os olhos, vamos sonhar!
line_table.english: Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!

line_table.text: Os amigos cantarolam a cantiga da Mamãe, bem devagar. E a Sandy dorme, dorme. Bons sonhos!
line_table.english: Her friends hum Mama's tune with her, soft and slow. And Sandy falls fast asleep. Sweet dreams!

line_table.text: O que ajudou a Sandy a dormir? A cantiga da Mamãe, ou um tambor bem alto?
line_table.english: What helped Sandy fall asleep? Mama's tune, or a loud drum?

line_table.text: Bom dia! O sol nasceu. E olha quem está no portão do zoológico!
line_table.english: Good morning! The sun is up. And look who is at the zoo gate!

line_table.text: Mamãe! Dormi a noite toda! Meus amigos cantaram sua cantiga.
line_table.english: Mama! I slept all night! My friends hummed your tune with me.

line_table.text: A Mamãe camelo e a Sandy cantarolam um oi, nariz com nariz.
line_table.english: Mama camel and Sandy hum hello, nose to nose.

line_table.text: Depois, a Mamãe e a Sandy voltam para casa, lado a lado.
line_table.english: Then Mama and Sandy walk home together, side by side.

line_table.text: Quem estava esperando no portão? A Mamãe, ou o Milo?
line_table.english: Who was waiting at the gate? Mama, or Milo?

line_table.text: Adorei a festa do pijama, Sandy!
line_table.english: Thank you for the sleepover, Sandy!

line_table.text: Volte sempre! Nosso celeiro também é seu.
line_table.english: Come again soon! Our barn is your barn too.

line_table.text: Obrigada, amigos! Minha primeira noite fora foi tão gostosa.
line_table.english: Thank you, friends! You made my first night away so cozy.

line_table.text: Na hora da saudade, uma cantiga de casa vai com você. E bons amigos ajudam.
line_table.english: When you miss someone, a song from home can come with you. And good friends help, too.

line_table.text: Você lembra? Quando um camelinho já anda ao lado da mamãe? Com meia hora de vida, ou com um ano?
line_table.english: Do you remember? When can a baby camel walk beside its mama? At half an hour old, or at one year old?

line_table.text: E o que protege os joelhos do camelo na areia quente? Pele grossa, ou penas macias?
line_table.english: And what keeps a camel's knees safe on hot sand? Tough skin, or soft feathers?

line_table.text: Lua redonda, estrelas a brilhar. Feche os olhos, vamos sonhar!
line_table.english: Moon is round, stars are bright. Close your eyes, and sleep tight!

line_table.text: Na próxima: a Poppy escorrega no gelo pela primeira vez! Até a próxima aventura, amigos!
line_table.english: Next time: Poppy's first slide on the ice! See you on the next adventure, friends!

line_table.text: The Animated Zoo!
line_table.english: The Animated Zoo!
